description:
Get COMMUNITY REPAIR STATISTICS from Open Repair Alliance data (300,000+ repair records).

USE THIS TOOL WHEN USERS ASK:
- "What's the success rate for [device type] repairs?"
- "How often do [device type] repairs succeed?"
- "What are the most common problems with [device type]?"
- "What's the typical fix rate for [problem]?"
- "Are [device type] repairs usually successful?"
- "What problems should I expect with my [device]?"
- "How likely is repair to work for [issue]?"
- "What are common repair barriers for [device]?"
- "At what age do [devices] typically fail?"
- "Repair success statistics for [category]"

COVERS: Smartphones, laptops, tablets, desktop computers, TVs, printers, small kitchen appliances, vacuum cleaners, power tools, headphones, gaming consoles, and more.

RETURNS: Fix rates by age and problem type, common failure patterns, repair barriers, and statistical confidence based on sample size.

category.description: Device category (e.g., 'smartphone', 'laptop', 'tablet', 'vacuum', 'printer'). Simple names are accepted and mapped to full slugs internally.

device_age_months.description: Device age in months (affects predicted fix rate)

name: get_repair_statistics
